Hi Elsa / Soojin — looping in the technical enablement team lead. A few notes from the enablement side: 

- Draft agenda for technical workshop (90 min): 15m Redwood platform overview; 25m hands-on model onboarding + sandbox walkthrough; 20m best-practices (batching, KV cache, quantization suggestions); 30m partner playbook & sales tooling (demo scripts, common Qs); 10m Q/A.
- Prework: SummitBridge needs a sandbox API key and a list of 2 POCs (low-PHI or non-PII) so we can pre-provision models. Please share customer names if the PoC is co-delivered.
- Certification: we'll provide a certification checklist (sales + tech) and a short quiz — recommended internal certification window is 2 weeks from workshop completion.

Attached: SB-SOW-draft.docx (redlines welcome). Also adding a suggested MAP (mutual action plan) in the Drive link.

On the SOW: standard Redwood pilot includes 4 weeks of runtime, up to 50k tokens/day test traffic, access to the Dedicated sandbox, and one co-delivered enablement session. Let us know if SummitBridge needs different throughput or data handling (e.g., dedicated VPC).
